css.description: The main color of the element's `data-ok-color`, as RGB channels.
css.name: --ok-c-channel

options.description: A step of the type scale; `inherit` (the default) keeps the font of the text around the link.
options.name: variant

options.description: Text color: a palette's `main` tone, a text tone, or `inherit` (the parent's color).
options.name: color

options.description: Text alignment. Without it, the text keeps the parent's alignment.
options.name: align

options.description: One line: overflowing text ends with an ellipsis (needs a block or inline-block with a width).
options.name: noWrap

options.description: When the link is underlined: `always`, on `hover` (pointer devices), or `none`.
options.name: underline

react.description: A Typography (`data-ok-typography` + `data-ok-link`) rendered as `a`, or as `<button type="button">` when there is neither `href` nor `component` (an action, not a destination). `href` passes through untouched; `target="_blank"` always gets `rel="noopener noreferrer"`.

props.description: Text alignment. Default: the parent's alignment (`"inherit"`).
props.name: align

props.description: A palette's `main` tone, a text tone, or `inherit`.
props.name: color

props.description: The element or component to render, such as a router link.
props.name: component

props.description: One line; overflowing text ends with an ellipsis.
props.name: noWrap
